history.prompt: Architectural photograph of a massive industrial loading dock at blue hour. A single glowing open bay door casts warm amber light onto the wet concrete of the yard, contrasting with the deep blue ambient twilight. A heavy freight trailer sits silhouetted in the shadows, disconnected from the safety of the facility. Long-exposure calm, atmospheric fog rolling in, no moving figures, highlighting the quiet vulnerability of a freight pickup point. Clean geometry, cinematic lighting, sophisticated color palette, wide anamorphic composition.

Cinematic film still, anamorphic 35mm look. A wide establishing composition of a commercial freight loading dock at dawn. A heavy articulated trailer is backed into an industrial warehouse bay under deep atmospheric haze. A single strong amber practical yard light illuminates the corrugated steel loading door against the cool teal shadows of the distribution center. Restrained teal-and-amber palette, deep shadows, moody industrial atmosphere. No people, quiet tension of the empty staging area.
